name: Amol

queries.query: Amol Iran official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry API
queries.result: Search identified the national Registration Organization of Deeds and Properties (SSAA) ecosystem and a local Amol registration-office reference, but no first-party public Amol parcel viewer, vector endpoint, or safe anonymous parcel response.

queries.query: آمل نقشه کاداستر رسمی املاک سازمان ثبت اسناد و املاک نقشه GIS سامانه
queries.result: نتایج به سازمان ثبت اسناد و املاک کشور، سامانه کاداستر و شمیم و یک مرجع محلی اداره ثبت اسناد و املاک شهرستان آمل اشاره کردند؛ هیچ لایه عمومی ناشناس با شناسه امن و هندسه قطعه برای آمل بازیابی نشد.

registryEvidence.candidateCustodian: Registration Organization of Deeds and Properties of Iran (SSAA), including its cadastral and Shamim systems
registryEvidence.scopeNote: The local-office result is a directory/map reference, not a first-party registry page. Official SSAA-related hosts were attempted but timed out, so a local registry/map/procedure was not sufficiently evidenced for registryFound=true. National cadastral prose is not treated as citywide public parcel coverage.

parcelDiscovery.note: No parcel polygon was retained. The exact WUP point was used only as the supplied research coordinate and was not shifted or treated as an absence test.

uncertainty: Ordinary HTTPS GET attempts to https://ssaa.ir, https://cadastre.ssaa.ir, https://shamim.ssaa.ir, https://my.ssaa.ir, and https://amol.ir did not return within the bounded timeout; no login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA, or certificate bypass was used.
Search results describe SSAA cadastral and Shamim services, but do not expose a public anonymous parcel-vector API or current viewer configuration for Amol.
The exact-point hit status, map extent status, and timeout status do not establish citywide cadastral absence.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, account, personal, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
